june 24 Notes:


I took 2 trades today, a loss, and then a perfect top tick limit order entry to pass my eval and now move on to the funded process.
,
The first trade that I took was around 10:00 and I took it because we had taken the pdl before 10:00 and we made an smt with an asian session low, which created a 15min bullish rb. 10:00 opened lower and traded into the 15min rb and made a 3min rb which I entered off of. I sadly entered right into consolidation and then we got another manipulation move down taking the 15m low once again. Nothing fundamentally wrong with this trade, but it unfortunately did not play out. (Screenshot 1)
,
The next trade that I took was a limit entry short. After we got a re-sweep of the 15minute low we got a hige move higher and I went to the 4h timeframe and saw there was a bunch of stacked highs and the ce of a 4h ob right above. I set my limit right on the ce and we swept the relative equal highs, tapped my level, and then dumped. This was the high of that 4h candle and was a very strong level. I am happy I took it with confidence and trusted my analysis today. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,
What I have learned recently is that my trading is a lot lot stronger when looking for entry triggers out of htf confluences (1h+) or even looking for limits from them. I lose when I try and read ltf pa and get manipulated or have an incorrect bias. It is also important to remember that now that I am moved to payout stage, absolutely nothing has changed and I should keep trading like normal. The only thing that should change is keeping the daily loss limit to 300. 1st trade $200 loss, second trade $100 loss. If I have to trade less contracts to make it work then that is ok, but keeping a strong risk management is what will get me to the payout.
,

jun 23 Notes:


I took two losses today, and I think it was a good example of try one trade, lose, try again, lose again, I’m offside today time to get off the charts.
,
The first trade I took was a long off of a 1min rb after tapping a 4h rb. 10:00 traded up with no manipulation lower and made relative equal highs, so once it traded back down into the range and tapped the 0.5 and the 4h rb and made a 1min rb I entered instantly and got a good reaction of about 40 points before getting stopped out. I could have trailed to breakeven once price hit 10:00 again, but I wanted to wait for the 5min to close before going be because we could have formed a 5min rb that we tapped. This was a really good trade and the only reason I would say it didn’t work out is because I was offside. Super solid though. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
I still was looking for longs after this so I waited for price to trade lower into ote and then we got a 5min rb that I entered off of and stopped on instantly. Also a good trade and apart of my model, but again I was just offside for this trade. I can’t really be upset about taking this trade because this is just how it goes sometimes. (Screenshot 3)
,
It is also unfortunate because I marked out the level to the bottom of nyam to the absolute tick. There was a previous week nwog/ volume imbalance on the daily and it aligned perfectly with the 4h 0.5 level and I was thinking that I would take this trade on paper, but it was a little too intimidating. Should have just had confidence in my level though, because it worked to the tick. (Screenshot 4 & 5)
,

messages.author: Zornik
messages.content_text:
Date: 23/06/2026

Session: NY am after big 1000 point expansion overnight...

Bias: We filled the whole gap on HTF, came into low volume node over the whole range that lined up with an HTF rb and -4.5 on the stdv where longs started initiating. (see first pic)

LT Bias: So first entry could have been on what I explained above but that was right at open so I don't want to get manipulated.  From that level it was straight pump not retrace. 10am also manipulation and straight up. Now the thing that caught me off guard is that we completely edged 1H gap, which already had el below it on LTF. Imo, we wanted to trade back to 10am, manipulate into 15m gap and long the the hourly fvg.



Entry: The mistake I made was on the entry, a bullish 5m rb was forming from tapping 0.5. There was one minute left, the wick was kinda big so hopped on 1m and took the 1m rb that rejected from the 1m ob. HOWEVER that bullish 5m rb never closed, flipped bearish, and stopped me out. Why was this also low probability? If I looked better on the 10am line, we tapped it and displaced from it, showing continuation of bearish orderflow.
 
Execution details: 10:53, 25 point stop, 7 RR, lost 95 dollar.

Mental state after trade/session: Good, realised the mistake, went on with my day, zero bad emotions tbh, glad I'm learning.

Result:  Loss
